title: Training Alignment Auditors via Reinforcement Learning

live_model.evidence: Table 1: 'GPT-4.1-nano [OpenAI, 2025a] 1.83 4.68 +2.86 32' (target susceptibility to hidden-behavior system prompts); A.3.8: 15 models, >55,000 scored evaluations.

prompt.location: Appendix A.1 (system prompt template), A.2 (32 hidden behaviours), A.3 (scenario and conversation-plan generation stages)
prompt.note: Conversations are generated by a multi-stage pipeline and scored by a Claude judge; not a single fixed prompt.

claim.metric: behavioral lift (judge score, behavior minus baseline)

notes: Judges are Claude Sonnet 4 (retired 2026-06-15 in target_models.json) and Opus 4.6; the live model is one of 15 secondary targets. Scenario generation also uses Anthropic models.
